verdict.rationale: Greptile supports on-demand review via CLI (`greptile review`), configurable strictness/noise control, custom rules, and per-branch settings via greptile.json read from the source branch, plus generic 'configure review triggers' in quickstart — giving developers some control over when/how reviews run. However there is no explicit evidence of skipping draft PRs or filtering by label, which the story specifically calls out. Missing for 10: explicit draft-PR skip toggle, label-based filtering, and independent confirmation these controls work as documented.
